query:
SELECT 
                COALESCE(b.amount, 0) as balance,
                a.mint_address as token_mint,
                a.symbol,
                a.decimals
            FROM assets a
            LEFT JOIN balances b ON a.id = b.asset_id AND b.user_id = $1
            WHERE a.symbol != 'SOL' AND (b.amount > 0 OR b.amount IS NULL)
            ORDER BY a.symbol
